title: Marella's Condo: Cozy, Central & Beach Walk
description: Experience Rincon like never before in our beachside apartment, "Marella's Apt: Cozy & Central." Perfectly situated near both the town and beach, it’s ideal for those seeking adventure or relaxation. Our apartment combines modern amenities with a cozy ambiance, ensuring a memorable stay. Surround yourself with style in this standout space, explore local cuisine, enjoy breathtaking sunsets, and indulge in the tranquility of our prime location.The spaceOur apartment is a haven of peace and convenience in Rincon's vibrant heart. It features a comfortable bedroom, a modern kitchen equipped for your culinary needs, and a stylish living area for ultimate relaxation. The balcony offers a serene spot to enjoy the scenic views of Rincon. Perfect for surf enthusiasts, culture seekers, or sun worshippers, our beachside apartment serves as the ideal backdrop for your Puerto Rican getaway.Guest accessGuests will have exclusive access to the entire condo, ensuring complete privacy and comfort during your stay. Enjoy full use of the bedroom, kitchen, living area, and balcony without any restrictions. Experience the convenience and freedom of having your own space in Rincon.

title: Mango Mountain #5 Two King's Surf View Suite

images.caption: We tried to find the largest couch in the Caribbean and to outfit it with enough pillows, art, and games to make your nights at home complete. If a night in, filled with comfort, fun, and relaxation doesn't suit you... you've picked the wrong place.

The great room of #5 Mango Mountain, our Two King's Suite, has the largest living area of all of our units, and is fully equipped with lots of games, yoga mats, beach towels, umbrellas, books, coolers, and 4 sets of snorkel gear.

Throw blankets, pillows, sunrise views over the Ceiba, and total relaxation in front of our giant flat screen... What more is there? A view to the ocean? Check! Steps from the kitchen and dining? Check!
Complimentary Farm Fresh free range organic eggs from our flock of happy hens... While supplies last each morning.

Vegan favorites from a local kitchen, with in-room delivery to Mango Mountain, include Nutty Balls, Hummus+Veg, Surf Scramble, BLT Sandwich, Vegi Deluxe, Creole Cutlet, Mac & Cheese, Quesadilla, and Guava’dilla. Enjoy fresh, plant-based goodness!

Local vegan faves: Balls $12, Soup $12, Chips & Dip $12, Hummus $14, Loaded Fries $16, No-Gurt $14, B’Rito $16, Scramble $18, Nuggs $16, BLT $18, Bolognese $24, Cutlet $22, Mac $20, Guava’dilla $11, Cheesecake $11.

Adjacent to the fully equipped kitchen, and next to the front door, we have the perfect place for morning coffee, or even meal-preps.

Flop onto the biggest bed around & get your vacation going. Lots of pillows, linens, sunrise valley, Ceiba, and pool views abound to keep you in the right frame of mind all vacation long. Draw the blackout curtains if you had a little too much fun.

description: #5 Mango Mountain, the King's Suite, is a fully equipped 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom apt. with a great room containing kitchen, dining, living, and office areas. This elevated escape overlooks the neighborhood and offers views of the steep terrain and rolling valleys directly to the ocean, providing endless sunsets. The casita also enjoys sunrises over the ceiba and the infinity pool, which are just a short walk down the stairs, past ample parking, gardens, picnic areas, fruit trees, y mucho mas.Guest access2,1.5

title: Rincon Beach Retreat
description: Great for families. Modern 3BR retreat near downtown Rincón and top beaches. Pack-and-play, beach wagon, towels, beach chairs, easy-set-up tent, and tarp blanket. Walk 0.5 miles to Stella Beach and a 2 grocery stores, with easy access to restaurants and the Rincon fitness center. Sandy’s and other surf spots are nearby. Features AC in every room, fast Starlink WiFi, Smart TV, full kitchen, washer/dryer, patio, parking. Comfortable king bed, bunk room, and office/daybed. Includes 2 surfboards!The spaceEnjoy privacy with no neighbors behind you, just fruit trees and a peaceful setting in a quiet, established neighborhood 5 min to Downtown. Perfect for afternoon walks to Stella Beach - just blocks away - known for beautiful sunsets and great snorkeling.The home features comfortable rooms with A/C and is ideal for families or weekend getaways. You can walk to Edwards Natural Foods, the Co-op grocery store, food trucks, smoothie shops, mail cetner, and Rincón Fitness Center.A special place to relax, explore, and enjoy the best of RincónGuest accessEasy check-in and out. You will receive a code to a lock box before your stay with access to keys for the front and side door.Other things to noteNestled in a quiet, established neighborhood, this home offers the perfect balance of convenience and tranquility. With no neighbors behind the property, you'll enjoy a peaceful setting surrounded by tropical fruit trees, making it easy to unwind after a day at the beach or exploring Rincón.We provide beach essentials, including a pack-and-play, beach wagon, towels, beach chairs, easy-set-up tent, a tarp blanket, and surfboards, so you can make the most of Rincón's world-class surf, swimming, and snorkeling. You'll be just minutes from the area's best beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, fitness options, and local favorites.For remote workers, reliable high-speed Starlink WiFi, a dedicated office space, great lighting, and a calm environment make it easy to stay productive while enjoying island life. For families, the spacious layout, bunk room, nearby beaches, and walkable grocery store create a comfortable home base for extended stays.

description: New Vegan(or Seagan) Meal Plan Available- breakfast & Dinner just ask! AC and smart TV in bedroom. Lush 1.5 acre property with many tropical fruit trees just 1 minute drive to Sandy Beach. Comfortably sleeps 2 or 3 with a Queen and a twin bed. We now run on solar power! Affordable retreat, yet close to everything! large size fridge better for longer stays! Beautiful plant filled deck with outdoor shower is a tropical dream!! Please note there is a jungle path and outdoor stairs to access rental.The spaceOur property is a nature lovers dream surrounded by fruit trees!(if you don’t love the sound of coqui frogs and tons of birds might not be for you;) The property just got a little more green. We are now powered by the 🌞 sun! We installed a 9.2Kw solar system. 23 panels charging two Tesla Powerwall batteries! When the grid fails, we don’t. 😎 We feel strongly about a clean healthy space and use all natural products. Your private apartment is on the backside lower level of our house, we live up top floor and there are 2 apartments on the middle level. We built a new wooden set of stairs away from the building so that all apartments have completely private entrances and decks. So you will need to reach your place via jungle paths and lots of stairs. The acre and a half property also has 2 wooden guest cottages and someday soon our new main house-we are working towards having a permaculture farm with all solar power!!Guest accessguests have a private parking space and access to over and acre of beautiful tropical property.Other things to noteThis apartment is best for small families or 2 adults or solo travelers-if you are 3 adults it will be cozy for you as it is a relatively small space;) Also best for water sports enthusiasts or other daytime adventurers-please note that the AC and TV are only in the bedroom and great for relaxing after a fun day out. We do have portable fans as well and if you prefer fresh breeze tons of screened windows. We run on solar power and also have a backup water system for outages. Also please note that you will need to access your place via jungle paths and lots of stairs!

description: Welcome to Casa Mar — a one-bedroom, two-bath unit in the heart of Puntas, Rincón. Just a short drive (5min) from Rincón’s legendary surf breaks—Pools, Sandy Beach Domes and Maria’s, Casa Mar offers you a comfortable home base in the town of beautiful sunsets. Our solar power system and satellite internet ensure your comfort while you are on the islandOur property has four units. The backyard and pool are shared with those other units.The spaceThis unit features a cozy queen bedroom with an ensuite bathroom and wardrobe area. The fully equipped kitchen and open living area make it easy to cook, chill, and unwind after a day in the salt and sun. It also has a second bathroom in the living area. This unit has its own rooftop area with a beautiful view of the coast and Aguadilla in the distance. This area is exclusive to Casa Mar's guests. The stairs to the rooftop are not for guests with mobility issues. This is a four unit property, each with a separate entrance. We have solar power, a backup water system and satellite internet.No smoking is allowed anywhere on the property.Guest accessWelcome to our little piece of paradise. We have a shared pool and tropical garden with beautiful plants and fruit trees. This is a four unit property. Each unit has a separate entrance.We are happy to lend you beach chairs, a cooler and umbrella.Residential area. We are on a beach access road.Other things to noteThis property is in a residential area. We are off of the famous Route 413 , affectionately called " the Road to Happiness". title: Pompeii 3
description: Treat yourself to an unforgettable getaway in our elegant and cozy apartment, the perfect place to rest and enjoy western Puerto Rico. Strategically located just 19 minutes from Rincón and its spectacular beaches, 13 minutes from the beautiful Aguada coast, and 27 minutes from the iconic Crash Boat beach in Aguadilla. Ideal for relaxing, exploring, and creating unique memories. 🌴✨The spaceThe space is modern, quiet and very cozy.Guest accessAt the moment, the property offers its comfortable apartments. A swimming pool will soon be added for the enjoyment of all our guests.Other things to noteThe property is located in a quiet area in the countryside, with typical Puerto Rican curves and slopes. Once you arrive, you'll enjoy a central location ideal for exploring the western area. Only 15 minutes from the beaches of Rincón by the country road, 8 minutes from Playa Pico de Piedras in Aguada and Olas Altas, 20 minutes from Rompeolas Beach and Playa Borinquén in Aguadilla, 30 minutes from the famous Crash Boat Beach and 38 minutes from Rafael Hernández International Airport.
